findings.title: Reject non-positive flusher process counts
findings.body: `--flusher-processes` accepts any integer, but this calculation can produce `num_processes == 0` for a value of zero (or a negative value). With assigned shards, the following mapping loop then evaluates `i % self.num_processes` and raises `ZeroDivisionError`, preventing the consumer from starting. Validate the option as positive or clamp/reject invalid values before building the shard map.
